title: Extending the singleton pure-tensor coface equation
statement: Let X,F,U,W,g and e(n) be as in the normalized degree comparison, without affineness assumptions. If e satisfies IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison in every degree, then e(n).hom followed by each Cech coface δ(j) equals the lifted Amitsur coface δ(j) followed by e(n+1).hom as additive group morphisms. [new-etale-affine-singleton-tensor-degree-comparison]

source.place: Tag 03P2, Theorem 59.22.4, affine-case proof, singleton Cech/Amitsur calculation; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P2

proof.text: Apply additive-group morphism extensionality and remove ULift. Ordinary tensor induction reduces to m tensor b; zero and addition are preserved. Indexed tensor induction writes b as sums of scaled pure tensors. Move the scalar from the indexed tensor to m using the balanced tensor relation, then apply the pure-tensor coface equation. This Lean proof closes the entire morphism equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03P2 affine calculation, expanded using Tag 03DR section restrictions, the affine sections formula, and tensor generators.

from.place: Affine singleton Cech/Amitsur calculation: separate terms from cofaces and then assemble the alternating differential.

lean.statement:
theorem singletonTensorDegreeComparison_coface
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U)
    (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ≅
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n)
    (he : ∀ n, IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparison X F U W g n (e n)) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤) := g.left.appTop.hom.toAlgebra
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (j : Fin (n + 2)),
      (e n).hom ≫ (singletonTensorCechCosimplicial X F U W g).δ j =
        (singletonTensorForget U.left).map
          ((Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurCosimplicialObject Γ(U.left, ⊤) Γ(W.left, ⊤)
            Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)).δ j) ≫ (e (n + 1)).hom
